label: Fluid tabs
desc: A tab bar whose pill or underline indicator springs and stretches between tabs, previews on hover, and scrolls with edge fades when crowded.
use: dashboard sections, settings pages, product detail views, publishing list filters

label: Glow sidebar
desc: A collapsible icon and label sidebar with a gliding active bar, tooltips in rail mode and a subtle brand glow that follows the pointer.
use: dashboard shell, admin area, connect page side navigation
